msg: There are 2 teams of gnomes - The yellow basket team and the red basket team. From what I could tell, Yellow basket gnomes were more consistent with their mushroom reward, whereas red basket gnomes were inconsistent and more of a gamble. The teams are as follows: Yellow Basket team is the BLUE GREEN YELLOW ORANGE gnomes.                    Red Basket team is the PURPLE BROWN RED PINK gnomes. The best advice i can give is to AVOID PINK AND BROWN gnomes at all costs. I would also advise to use your x1 rounds to feel out the gnome's mushroom range, and on your x5 rounds to secure as many points securely with the yellow basket team. good luck!
